judged_text: The zoho-bigin refresh call passes `credentialId` (the credential row id) as the userId parameter that every other call site fills with `credential.userId`, so the sync request posts `calcomUserId=<credential id>`. With credential sharing enabled, the parent app resolves that value to a different or nonexistent user and returns that user's Zoho tokens — syncing another user's credentials into this user's credential row, or breaking the token mapping entirely.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the third argument is treated as a Cal.com *userId* (`calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). Every other updated call site passes `credential.userId`, but in `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts` the call passes `credentialId` (`refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`). Based on the diff, this is inconsistent with the intended parameter and would cause the sync request to post `calcomUserId=<credentialId>` when credential sharing is enabled, potentially mapping tokens to the wrong/nonexistent user.
